title: Pilot Delivery Playbook — Scope, Weekly Sprint Grid, and Workshop Scripts
content:
Purpose and context:
This is a living playbook for a medium-complexity customer pilot (multi-tenant chat + embeddings). It consolidates scope, week-by-week sprint grid, task owners, and two workshop scripts (kickoff + integration). Use as the canonical working doc during the pilot.

Top-level objectives:
- Validate latency and cost targets for the customer workload with Redwood Dedicated profile B (8xA10G equivalent).
- Demonstrate reliable throughput for concurrent chat sessions (SLO: p95 < 220ms for short-turn chat).
- Confirm integration points and exportable logs for customer audit requirements.

Success criteria (must-have to call pilot successful):
1) End-to-end demo with customer L2 showing generation + embedding pipeline under realistic query mix.
2) Observability: per-route token cost and latency dashboard set up in Console with sample alerts firing on injected faults.
3) Performance baseline: throughput >= 80 concurrent sessions sustained for 15 minutes without queue growth; cost/unit within 15% of forecast.

High-level timeline (6 calendar weeks) — milestones:
- Week 0 (pre-kickoff): contracts, infra reservation, onboarding package sent.
- Week 1: Kickoff workshop + initial model verification on customer sample prompts.
- Week 2: Integration sprint (SDK + network config), basic evals and perf smoke tests.
- Week 3: Stress tests, batch/kv cache tuning, begin golden-path demo prep.
- Week 4: Canary rollout to small customer traffic, run observability tuning.
- Week 5: Full demo + acceptance testing with customer L2, collect feedback and handoff notes.

Weekly sprint grid (owner shorthand in parentheses):
- Week 0 (Aisha): Reserve Dedicated pool, create temp creds, send onboarding packet, confirm customer infra windows.
- Week 1 (Marco/Elena): Kickoff workshop (script below), capture integration checklist items, run quick model sanity checks.
- Week 2 (Devon): Implement SDK integration snippets, CI smoke (integration tests), open tickets for network/NAT issues.
- Week 3 (Priya/Eng SRE): Load testing, enable KV cache, evaluate quantization tradeoffs if needed; document perf deltas.
- Week 4 (Marco): Start canary, collect traces and token-level cost; iterate alert thresholds.
- Week 5 (Aisha/All): Acceptance demo, collect signed acceptance, compile handoff doc and runbook for ops.

Task tracker (working shorthand — update status on Monday standups):
- Provision Dedicated pool (Aisha) — status: in_progress — action: confirm GPU SKU + region by 2025-11-08.
- Generate sample prompt-set (Customer + Solutions) (Elena) — status: done — notes: 120 prompts canonicalized into JSONL.
- Create test harness for concurrency (Devon) — status: in_progress — PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/poc-samples/pull/43.
- Console dashboards (Marco) — status: todo — includes routes, per-token cost, error budget panels.
- Audit log export (Priya) — status: todo — need KMS policy from customer.

Workshop scripts (lightweight, copy-paste for calendar invite notes):
1) Kickoff (90 minutes) — attendees: customer engineering, solutions-eng, SRE (optional)
  - 0-10m: Intros & success criteria alignment (Aisha)
  - 10-25m: Architect walkthrough — data flow, security boundaries, required network ports (Marco)
  - 25-45m: Demo of Redwood Console + sample pipeline using customer prompts (Elena)
  - 45-65m: Integration checklist review (Devon) — SDK endpoints, auth, timeout/ retry config
  - 65-85m: Risk & schedule readout, next steps (Aisha)
  - 85-90m: Q/A and action item capture (All)

2) Integration deep-dive (60 minutes) — aimed at engineers implementing SDK
  - 0-15m: Quick architecture recap and auth flow (Devon)
  - 15-35m: Live pairing: run sample requests against Dedicated pool, inspect KV cache behavior (Marco)
  - 35-50m: Failure mode demo: simulate throttling and fallback to hosted variant (Priya)
  - 50-60m: Open issues and assignment of follow-ups (All)

Pre-req checklist for customer before Week 1 (share in invite):
- Provide sample prompt/embedding corpus (JSONL) and an allowlist of test user ids.
- Open a dedicated Slack channel and invite solutions-eng leads.
- Confirm IP ranges and any outbound firewall egress rules.
- Share KMS key policy sketch for audit exports.

Risk register (top 5 working items):
- Network egress blocks customer <-> Dedicated pool (mitigation: fall back to hosted region mirror; ticket with customer network team).
- Token cost surprises with long-context prompts (mitigation: guardrails + early quantization test).
- Model compatibility regression when switching model variants (mitigation: pin seed model version and capture evals).
- Observability gaps (mitigation: ship minimal dashboard early and iterate).
- Scheduling conflicts for GPU reservation (mitigation: 2 backup dates and cross-region option).

Acceptance tests and sampling plan:
- Run 3x baseline runs: short-turn chat (avg 25 tokens), long-turn summarization (avg 1.2k tokens), embedding batch (10k queries). Capture p95 latency, tail errors, and token cost.
- Compare run results to forecast table in Confluence (linked).

Open questions (to resolve during Week 0 call):
- Is the customer comfortable with on-the-fly quantization experiments during the pilot or do they require a separate opt-in? (owner: Aisha)
- Which SLAs need to be attached to the canary traffic? (owner: Marco)
- Who is the customer's audit contact for KMS/HSM discussions? (owner: Priya)

Next steps (immediate):
- Aisha to confirm Dedicated pool SKU and submit infra request by 2025-11-06.
- Elena to finalize prompt-set and post to shared folder.
- Schedule kickoff workshop for the week of 2025-11-10 (options: Tue/Wed mornings).

Notes to self / working reminders (informal):
- Keep workshop slides minimal — focus on live demo and integration checklist.
- Bring a simple failure injection script to the integration workshop.
- Make sure Demo always uses a pinned model variant for reproducibility.

References and quick links:
- Confluence: Pilot-Onboarding-Checklist (linked above)
- Jira board: ENG-PILOT-812 (watchers: solutions-eng)
- GitHub sample harness PR included in linked_artifacts

If anything changes, update this doc and add timestamped notes in the activity section below.

Activity log (chronological, append-only):
- 2025-11-04: Document created (Aisha)
- 2025-11-06: Dedicated pool SKU confirmed (Aisha)
- 2025-11-08: Prompt set finalized and uploaded (Elena)
- 2026-01-12: Load test scripts updated (Devon)
